name: Honda ADV150 / ADV160
engine: 149 or 157 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected, CVT
intro: Honda's adventure-styled small scooter. Some 2024-2025 ADV160s have an oil pump recall that can leave you without drive.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2024-2025 ADV160s are in recall 25V195 (oil pump driven gear).
A-002.reason: If the gear fails you lose drive power. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Oil pump driven gear may fail, causing a loss of drive power.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the oil pump driven gear free.
